verdicts.domain: Live logo upload widget for Day-1 Act 1 (multipart POST)
verdicts.evidence: 20/20 new tests + 23/23 existing Day-1 tests OK. MIME sniffed via magic bytes (PNG 89 50 4E 47, JPEG FF D8 FF, WebP RIFF+WEBP); PDF disguised as PNG rejected (test_pdf_disguised_as_png_rejected_via_mime_sniff); SVG rejected (XSS risk). CSRF protected — verifier hard-fails on any @csrf_exempt or method_decorator(csrf_exempt). Tenant isolation: `school = getattr(request, 'school', None)` — never `request.POST['school_id']` (test_tenant_isolation_school_resolved_from_request_not_post_body asserts POST body attack rejected). `_read_upload_bounded` uses chunked read so oversize files never materialize in memory. Atomic transaction wraps `school.save()` + branding_metadata update. School slug → sha256[:8] in logs; bytes never logged.

verdicts.domain: Tone-aware E1 palette overload (classic / warm / vibrant / neutral)
verdicts.evidence: 81/81 tests OK (10 new + 71 existing — full backwards compatibility). 4 tones implemented: classic (seed-proximate, balanced), warm (hue rotated ~70% toward 30° orange), vibrant (saturation +0.15), neutral (saturation collapsed to 0.25). `tone=None` produces byte-identical stops vs no-kwarg call (test_tone_none_preserves_existing_behavior). AI prompt includes tone directive from `_TONE_DIRECTIVES` table (test_tone_appears_in_ai_prompt). Rules-layer diversity proven: warm vs classic pairwise hue distance > 10° at stop 500 even on AI-unreachable rules path. WCAG 4.5:1 (AA) anchor pair holds for all 4 tones (snap applies AFTER tone shift). Day-1 Act 2 now calls `ai_palette.generate_palette_from_seed(seed_hex, mode='dual', request=request, tone=tone)` directly per variation — removed the tone→mode coerce hack.
